headline: Both coolers block 120 percent throughput
summary: At 120% (21.6 m3/h) both coolers miss targets in run 120pct_base: H1007 makes 35.81 C vs 35 C limit and H1008 makes 21.28 C vs 20 C limit. Raising cooling water to 30 m3/h and chilled water to 20 m3/h together passes in run 120pct_maxUtil: 34.54 C and 19.37 C, within all utility and frame limits.

proposals.title: Turn up cooling water to use spare header
proposals.why: Cheapest for H1007: operating change only. Verified in 120pct_CW30only (34.54 C, 94% area) and together in 120pct_maxUtil. Within DN80 limit 30 m3/h, frame stays 46.8/60 m2.

proposals.title: Turn up chilled water to use spare header
proposals.why: Cheapest for H1008: operating change only. Verified in 120pct_CHW20only (19.92 C, 98.8% area) and together in 120pct_maxUtil (19.37 C). Within branch limit 20 m3/h. Both increases needed together; cleaning H1007 to 900 still needed CHW 18 in 120pct_clean+CHW18 so costs more.
